title: The Light Bulb Inventor
text:
Thomas Edison was a famous inventor. In 1879 he made a practical light bulb. He had many patents for his inventions. He worked in a large laboratory in New Jersey.

Edison was very curious. He tested new ideas every day, even when his experiments failed. Many of his inventions are still used today. His hard work changed the way people lived.

options: In a large laboratory in New Jersey

questions.text: What did Edison do every day?
Why is Edison's work still important today?
options: Many of his inventions are still used by people
He stopped working early in life

questions.text: What can the reader infer about Edison's personality?
options: He was afraid of new ideas
